_comment: Annual events whose own site states the date only in a sentence, read by mapsee_ingest_annual.py. Identity, venue and coordinates are curated here; the DATE, the clock and the publisher's own FREE sentence are read from the site on every run and never stored, as fair_sources.json does. shape 'day': the site is the event's own, single days count, and name_rx is required and names the EVENT, not the organiser ('short\s+run\s+comix', not 'short\s+run': every post on an organiser's homepage says its name, and the nearest named date wins); a date is believed only with that name within 90 characters before it, never across another date, or in its own paragraph. shape 'range': ranges only, as the fairs adapter. 'pages' (optional) are read in order only while the homepage has given nothing upcoming and has not said the edition's own hours ended today; no other link is followed. The venue is re-checked against the publisher each edition: it is curated, not scraped.
